text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board spending approval for 2020 State of Good Repair and Facility Fee Reserve Fund projects.

The TO Live Audit Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the 2020 State of Good Repair capital projects listed in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 31, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live and all related purchase orders and/or tender awards over $100,000 up to each individual project budget or adjusted budget (if necessary), not to exceed the available 2020 State of Good Repair funding, pending approval of the 2020 TO Live Capital Budget at the February 19, 2020 City of Toronto Council meeting. 2.
